name: Unleash Cloud
description: Unleash Cloud provides feature flags, activation strategies, environments, segments, variants, dependencies, and release controls.
agentUseSummary: Connect a backend token scoped to one non-production project and environment on an allowlisted Unleash Cloud instance. Relay approval-gates bounded feature metadata reads while enabled states, evaluation configuration, contexts, payloads, dependencies, Admin APIs, and mutations remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: UNLEASH_CLOUD_BACKEND_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Unleash Cloud backend token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated backend token scoped to one project and one non-production environment.

credentialRequirements.name: UNLEASH_CLOUD_INSTANCE_URL
credentialRequirements.label: Unleash Cloud instance URL
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the exact hosted instance URL, such as https://us.app.unleash-hosted.com/instance-id.

credentialRequirements.name: UNLEASH_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Unleash Cloud project ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Record the single project encoded in the backend token.

credentialRequirements.name: UNLEASH_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT
credentialRequirements.label: Unleash Cloud environment
credentialRequirements.helpText: Record the single non-production environment encoded in the backend token.

capabilities.label: Read feature metadata
capabilities.description: Read bounded project and environment-scoped feature metadata with approval.

approvalRequired.label: Read Unleash Cloud features
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded project and environment-scoped feature metadata.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Backend tokens and authorization headers never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Read evaluation configuration
blocked.description: Enabled states, strategies, constraints, context values, segments, variants, payloads, dependencies, evaluation inputs, and raw token scope are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate Unleash
blocked.description: Feature, environment, strategy, segment, project, token, service account, and every other mutation remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only Client API feature list and exact GETs run on an allowlisted Unleash Cloud instance with stored project/environment binding; Admin, Frontend, Edge, arbitrary paths, queries, evaluation, and self-hosted origins are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Both metadata reads require approval; backend-token scope, hosted-instance allowlist, project/environment binding, bounds, redaction, audits, and evaluation/mutation blocks remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The selected metadata read runs without Relay approval; backend-token scope, hosted-instance allowlist, project/environment binding, bounds, redaction, audits, and evaluation/mutation blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway attaches the encrypted scoped backend token server-side and mounts two approval-gated metadata reads.
Railway attaches the encrypted scoped backend token server-side and mounts two approval-gated metadata reads.

providerSetup.blocker: Unleash Cloud requires a customer instance and dedicated backend token scoped to one non-production project and environment. This worker may not create or configure them.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create the scoped staging token outside this worker, configure token, hosted instance URL, project, and environment in Railway staging, then verify binding, reads, redaction, approvals, bounds, revocation, disconnect, and denial.

evidence.supports: Unleash's official API overview documents the Client API, Authorization header, backend token secrecy and project/environment scope, service boundaries, and hosted OpenAPI access.
Unleash's official Client API reference pins feature list response fields including states, strategies, variants, segments, and query data that Relay strips.
Unleash's official exact feature reference pins the safe feature-name route, backend-token authentication, and response fields.
Unleash documents Cloud instance URLs such as https://us.app.unleash-hosted.com/instance-id, supporting the hosted-origin allowlist.
